headline: Tom Hiddleston reveals his Everest-ready Avenger
post:
Marvel star Tom Hiddleston recently chatted about his new biographical drama Tenzing, where he plays Sir Edmund Hillary scaling Mount Everest. During the chat, he was asked which Avenger he would trust on the mountain. 

Hiddleston defended Loki's cold-weather skills, but joked about potential backstabbing. For actual climbing power, he mentioned Thor and the Hulk, while ruling out flying characters like Iron Man to avoid cheating! 

Which Avenger do you think would be the best climbing partner? 

#TomHiddleston #Tenzing #Avengers
original_title: Tenzing Star Tom Hiddleston On Which Avenger He’d Trust For A Climb Up Mount Everest (Exclusive)

headline: Vader lightsaber hits million dollar start
post:
Get ready for some serious Star Wars history to hit the auction block! Heritage Auctions is putting up the screen-used lightsaber wielded by Darth Vader during pivotal moments like the Cloud City duel in The Empire Strikes Back.

Built from a 1950s camera flash and other found objects, this iconic weapon has a starting price of $1 million and goes to auction on November 12. 

Would you bid on this legendary piece of movie history?

#StarWars #DarthVader #Lightsaber
original_title: It Will Cost $1 Million to Own the Ultimate Screen-Used Star Wars Grail (And That Is Just the Starting Price)

headline: Classic Marvel Heroes Who Became Vampires
post:
Hey everyone! Did you know that classic Marvel characters have undergone dramatic transformations over the years? According to Screen Rant, several well-known heroes across main continuity and alternate timelines have fallen to vampirism. 

From Black Panther and Doctor Strange getting bitten during the 2024 Blood Hunt event to Wolverine and Jubilee facing the undead in the Curse of the Mutants storyline, these dark transformations drastically altered their stories. Even characters with powerful healing factors and incredible willpower have found themselves vulnerable to the curse at one point or another.

Which of these surprising vampire transformations shocked you the most?

#Marvel #Vampires #Superheroes
original_title: 8 Classic Marvel Superheroes Even Mega-Fans Didn't Realize Have Been Vampires

headline: Milly Alcock clears her Supergirl posts
post:

headline: Daredevil and Captain Marvel romance teased
post:
Marvel is reportedly teasing a brand-new comic romance that has the internet talking. According to Screen Rant, a recent New York Comic Con trailer for Chip Zdarsky and Marco Checchetto's "Avengers #1" hints at a pairing between Matt Murdock's Daredevil and Carol Danvers. 

Clips from the preview show the heroes bantering, with Carol calling Matt "handsome" and even kissing his cheek. Yet social media reactions have been quite tumultuous. Supporters point out that Matt's chaotic love life and history of harming partners make him a risky match. Meanwhile, Carol's willingness to use lethal force clashes with the Man Without Fear's strict legal code. 

Despite these thematic differences, top creative teams are handling the characters. Whether this unexpected dynamic becomes an entertaining disaster or a massive misstep remains to be seen. 

#Avengers #Daredevil #CaptainMarvel
original_title: Marvel Is Threatening The Worst Avengers Romance Of All Time, Bar None

headline: Action Comics #1103 retcons Superman's origin
post:
Superman history is seeing some major shifts in Action Comics #1103 following the Kingdom of Zod storyline. Instead of just lifting furniture as a kid, young Clark now lifts the entire Kent family home, leaving Martha Kent looking on with bewilderment and fear at his incomprehensible strength.

This modern update adds a new layer of vulnerability as Clark learns the importance of humility alongside his incredible gifts. What do you think of this massive change to Clark Kent's childhood?

#Superman #DCComics #ActionComics
original_title: After 88 Years, DC Retcons Superman's Iconic Origin
